notes.title: Nice big update on our upcoming release!
notes.notes:
Hello, horror fans!

We know it's been a little while since we announced the game, so here's a quick update on what's up:

[h1]About the Steam release[/h1]
Our first release for [i]Worse Than Death[/i] was on iOS in July, and since that very successful launch, we've been prepping the Steam and console versions. Because we're such a small studio (2 people!), we have to be smart about what we work on when. 

[b]TL;DR: [i]Worse Than Death[/i] will be launching here at the end of this summer, and it's going to be worth the wait![/b]


[h1]Amazing critical reception[/h1]
Obviously we dig our own game, but we're not alone! Check out what the (gasp) [b][i]Los Angeles Times[/i][/b] had to say about the game:

[quote=LA Times]
"For those who have been binge-watching the latest season of ‘Stranger Things,’ this like-minded genre mashup … may be a rather welcome dessert."[/quote]

There are links to this review and more [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029100/Worse_Than_Death/]right on the store page.[/url]

[h1]Video interview about [i]Worse Than Death[/i][/h1]
We sat down with gaming channel Squad State this summer to talk all about the game, working as a small studio, and making cool horror stuff. Watch it here!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8BH1pTcLAxE

[h1]The road to launch[/h1]
We'll continue to post updates as we get close to launch; we can't wait for you to get your hands on the game (especially if you play with a gamepad — the "stereo rumble" system we've created is pretty cool).

In the meantime, you can keep in touch:
[list]
[*][url=http://twitter.com/benjaminrivers]on Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/RwaUFkW]on our friendly Discord server[/url]
[*][url=http://www.twitch.tv/benjaminriversinc]by watching our streams on Twitch[/url]
[/list]

See you again soon; stay spooked out there!

B.
